thread:
IncidentBot: Alert: elevated streaming-response queue depth on prod-us-east-1 for /v1/generate-stream. Tail latency spike and memory pressure detected. Auto-escalation -> paging oncall.
Jordan: I'm oncall — paging in. Priya, can you look at runtime queues and memory?
Priya: Looking now. I see connection pileup on route /v1/generate-stream (model=open-rlhf-13b). Streaming connections are holding KV caches; GPU memory trending up.
Marco: Confirmed. One pod in pool 'dedicated-13b-1' at 92% GPU mem, repeated GC and slow epoll wakeups. Logs show repeated frame flush delays.
Elena: Customer impact: 3 high-throughput tenants reporting stalled completions/timeouts. Support queue has 2 P1 escalations.
Jordan: Mitigation proposal: temporarily disable streaming responses for that model route and serve full responses (non-streaming) as a graceful degrade. Also apply an emergency rate-shaper on streaming connections. Thoughts?
Sophie: +1 from support. Customers prefer slower complete responses over intermittent stalls. We'll want a short status ping to affected tenants.
Aaron: Product concurs. Graceful degrade is preferable to dropping requests. Keep me posted on rollback criteria.
Priya: I'll execute runbook step: flip feature flag for streaming off for that route and scope to high-throughput tenants. Then apply connection cap.
Marco: Quick check — if we disable streaming, worker memory should drop because KV lifetime shortens; expect some median latency increase but tail should improve.
Priya: Executing now. Commands:
```bash
# disable streaming on route
redwoodctl feature-flag set --route /v1/generate-stream --flag enable_streaming_v1=false --env prod
# apply emergency shaping
redwoodctl shaping apply --route /v1/generate-stream --max-conns 120 --burst 30 --env prod
```
Jordan: Proceed. Make sure change is logged as incident-chg.
Priya: Feature flag set. Shaping applied. Patching ingress to prefer non-streaming handler.
IncidentBot: config change recorded: change_id=chg_2026_1767778888_01.
Jordan: Confirming deployment diffs look clean. Watching metrics.
Priya: GPU mem dropping on the stressed pod from 92% -> 60% in under 2 minutes. Connection queue length down ~70%.
Marco: Good signal. Non-streaming median latency +60ms, but p99 improved ~45%. No new OOMs observed.
Elena: Sending interim customer note now: "We're temporarily switching your requests to non-streaming responses to stabilize latency and prevent timeouts. Expect slightly higher single-response latency; throughput will be stable. We'll notify when streaming is reenabled."
Sophie: Support ticket INC-3421 updated with mitigation details and customers notified.
Jordan: Handoff: Priya will observe and execute gradual reenable plan. I'll step out for a short break and sleepwatch.
Priya: Ack. Reenable plan: ramp streaming back in at 5% traffic slices every 2 minutes with the following rollback conditions: GPU mem >85% on any pod OR p95 request latency >800ms OR error rate increase >0.5%. If triggered, revert to non-streaming and reapply shaping.
Aaron: Post-incident actions: owner Aaron for postmortem. Long-term fixes: connection eviction heuristics, streaming backpressure improvements, and per-tenant streaming quotas.
Jordan: Good. Logging incident notes and handoff. I'll mark this as mitigated for paging; oncall handoff -> Priya (observe). :white_check_mark:
Priya: 30m check-in: metrics stable, no regressions, prepared to run the reenable schedule in 5m. Will report each increment.
Jordan: Thanks team. Leaving the channel.
Priya: 5% -> 10% -> 20% traffic increments applied over 10m with close monitoring; slight uptick in GPU mem at 20% but within thresholds.
Marco: Watching low-level metrics; KV cache hit rate consistent, epoll wait reduced.
Elena: Customers confirm degraded-but-functional behavior. No new support P1s.
Priya: At 45m total we are at 50% streaming traffic with stable metrics. Preparing next increments.
Aaron: Captured action items: (1) implement automatic connection eviction on sustained idle frames, (2) improve streaming backpressure signals to the router, (3) add per-route circuit-breakers for streaming.
Jordan: Final: mitigation applied and validated, oncall handoff complete, postmortem owner assigned. We'll reopen if signals regress. Thanks all.
